project_title: Prodata Phone & Accessories Stock Management & POS System
archetype: Swiss Tactical Precision & Old Money Tech

responsive.layout: Mobile-first single column stacked view reflowing to multi-column grid on md/lg. POS live cart transforms into bottom sheet drawer on mobile and sticky side panel on desktop. Fast access grid buttons on mobile home.
responsive.typography: Fluid rem scaling. Headings adapt from text-2xl on mobile up to text-4xl/5xl on desktop. Inputs maintain minimum 16px (1rem) font size on mobile to prevent browser zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root and table wrappers with horizontal scroll indicators for data tables.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px touch targets for all interactive buttons, quantity selectors, barcode scanners, and IMEI pill buttons.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800/80 (Dark) or backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border border-slate-200 (Light)
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp border using #233044 in dark mode and #E2E8F0 in light mode
visual_enhancers.imei_badge_style: Font-mono text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30

grids.dashboard_mode: MODE B: High Density Data Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4)
grids.pos_mode: 2-Column Split POS Screen (Left 70% Product Search & Grid, Right 30% Cart & Checkout on Desktop; Stacked with Slide-over Drawer on Mobile)

layouts.sidebar: Collapsible vertical navigation bar with active route highlighting, store identity header, and quick sales trigger.
layouts.topbar: Search bar with barcode scan keyboard shortcut, active user role badge (Admin/Employee), currency indicator (EUR), debt alerts indicator, and quick theme toggle.
layouts.pos_terminal: Instant filtering by Category (Phones vs Accessories), Brand (Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi), IMEI search bar, and live quantity calculator.

motion.cart_add_animation: Micro scale pulse 1.05x on button click + toast confirmation via Sonner
motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion with instant fallback opacity transitions

accessibility.apca_contrast: High contrast compliance (minimum 4.5:1 text vs card background)
accessibility.test_ids: Mandatory data-testid on every interactive element and data cell

3d_libraries.canvas_decorations: Lucide react icons + optional subtle tsParticles / geometric subtle grid background canvas

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure complete responsive mobile-first UI for phone and accessories store stock management.

Provide a full-featured POS / Sales screen where employees can select phones by unique IMEI or accessories by quantity, attach customer info, select payment method (Cash, Card, Debt/Kredi), and generate downloadable PDF invoices in EUR.

Implement clear role-based UI for Admin and Employee (Admin accesses reports, profit margins, debt settlement, employee management, settings; Employee handles POS sales, stock lookup, customer registration).
Include IMEI tracking section inside product creation & inventory tables with search, filter, and barcode capabilities.

Make sure all interactive and key data display elements include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='pos-checkout-btn', data-testid='product-imei-input', data-testid='sales-total-value').
Use Sonner for toast notifications on item addition, inventory updates, and debt status changes.
Use currency formatted in EUR (€) across all views.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use pure black #000000 or default raw blue. Always use tinted high-contrast neutrals with emerald and indigo accents.
Ensure all forms use Shadcn inputs, selects, dialogs, and popovers with explicit hover/focus text colors.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, and modal triggers.
Mobile layout must stack gracefully into single column with tap targets at least 44px height.
